methods: SQLite readonly; graph roles matched only to the four explicitly observed kernel signatures and native call counts.
All unions use timestamps within their own process/device trace. NULL graphId and0 are both eager.
Graph medians and last24-target envelopes retain target/draft work distinctions; no claim of equal token continuation or numerical tree.

The first24 captured-target windows do not align the true logical decode start: peer already executed eager target/draft work before its first capture. Compare Hyle early-to-late descriptively; Hyle/peer first24 cold-cost difference is not an aligned causal contrast.
All-GPU intervals include loading. First-to-last-kernel includes cold prep/prefills. Warm envelope includes24 captured targets and any intervening draft/eager/copies, not entire decode.
Sum of durations and unoccupied intervals are descriptive, not promised recoverable wall time. No cross-process clocks are subtracted.
